concept.title: Review task header
concept.shortdesc: The review task header stays available while you work in a task and shows task details, status information, and actions such as sharing, viewing owner details, and requesting re-review.

conbody.p: When a review task is open, the upper part of the header stripe remains available no matter which page you open inside the task. This keeps the main navigation options and the breadcrumb available at all times.

fig.title: Review Task Header Stripe (Independent Review Task)

section.title: Header details and actions
section.p: The lower part of the header changes depending on the page context and your role in the task. It can show the task title, the review status, the task owners, the number of reviewers who have finalized the task, and the due date, if a due date is configured in the Task Settings page. You can click More Details to see additional information such as the creation time and the current branch for project review tasks.
If you are a task owner, you can click Share to configure access to the task.
You can click the Owners area to see information about the task owners.
You can click the Finalized widget to see the status for each assigned reviewer.

section.title: Re-review and changed files
section.p: If a task owner clicks the Finalized widget for a task where reviewers have finalized their review, the task owner can use the Request re-review button. This resets the finalized status for all reviewers and changes their status to In progress. If the task owner reopens a closed task, the finalized status is also reset for all reviewers.

Users who are assigned to the task but have not yet accessed it are labeled as Pending in the Review Status Summary pop-up window. This helps task owners identify users who have not yet responded to the review request.

When a reviewer opens a task after the owner requested another review, the Task Files page includes a Changed files only filter. This makes it easier to identify the files that changed and need another review.
